mainEntity.name: How long do dermal fillers last?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the product and the area treated. Your dermatologist will explain how long results should last and what maintenance your plan needs.
No recovery time is needed. Avoid strenuous exercise and heat for 24–48 hours after treatment.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between fillers and Botox?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fillers restore lost volume and contour, while Botox relaxes the muscles that cause expression lines. The two are often combined.
